categories.label: Team won (final Ruffian defeated)

categories.label: Final Fight special objective completed
categories.labelVi: Hoàn thành mục tiêu đặc biệt của Final Fight
categories.hint: Optional bonus objective of the Final Fight; it leads to a different ending.

winCondition: A game is 4 rounds (3 in 3-Round Mode); each round is a Town Phase then a Fight Phase against one Ruffian. Defeat the Ruffian in every fight, including the Final Fight, to win. You lose if all townsfolk are knocked out during a fight (or all remaining townsfolk are removed with no way to return), or if a Final Fight's own lose condition triggers. A Final Fight can end in 3 endings: win, win with its special objective, or loss.

endCondition.description: Defeat 4 Ruffians (3 in 3-Round Mode); the last is the Final Fight

notes: family: coop. No victory points; Coins and Feats of Mettle only feed in-game progression. Players may also play solo. Ruffian count is 3 in 3-Round Mode (rules on p.34). Several Ruffians and Final Fights have their own extra lose conditions (scenario cards).
